lead.jd_excerpt: Install, calibrate, and commission Particle Size Analyzers, XRF instruments, and Spectroscopy devices at customer sites. Perform preventive maintenance on analytical and scientific equipment to ensure reliability and accurate results. Troubleshoot, diagnose, and repair any equipment faults or performance issues promptly. Ensure all work complies with industry standards and quality procedures. Requirements: Degree in Engineering At least 2 years of experience in servicing semiconductor instruments. Strong knowledge of laboratory analytical techniques, including spectroscopy, XRF, and particle size analysis. If you are keen to apply for the position, kindly email your detailed resume in MS Word to hr@recruit-expert.com Please note that only shortlisted candidates will be notified. For more job opportunities, please visit our website at www.recruit-expert.com EA Licence: 19C9701 Registration: R1326740
